181.common: Matched instrument: the same binary, --slot-fork-min-tokens off (0) vs on (N), the same prompt set and argv. Raw counts per sibling (n_fork_tokens from the request timings and from /slots, the KPF-11 prediction, the checkpoint set that existed) are kept; every sibling counts, including errors; results are COUNTS under rule_result, never a pass word. Held-out rule: the predictor is the handoff's KPF-11 rule (largest checkpoint n_tokens <= lcp with p < task size); nothing is fitted on these cells.
181.A: A_ckpt: slot 0 prefills trunk(T)+private tail with checkpoint_at=[T]; each sibling = trunk + its own suffix (distinct first tokens) on slot 1, one at a time, fork on. SATISFIED iff every sibling n_fork_tokens == T. A_tailonly: same without checkpoint_at; RECORDED only (expected near 0: the source's near-end checkpoints lie past the shared prefix): counts of n_fork_tokens == 0 and the max. Fork-off arms (min tokens 0): SATISFIED iff every sibling n_fork_tokens == 0.
181.B: B1 identical resend of trunk+suffix0 (source without checkpoint_at), B2 the same with checkpoint_at [-1], B3 child == trunk with the source = trunk+suffix0 pinned at T, B4 child == trunk with the source = the trunk alone. Each child is on slot 1, fork on, after the source's own n_predict-0 prefill. SATISFIED iff (a) every child n_fork_tokens equals the KPF-11 prediction, (b) no child has n_fork_tokens == 0 while a usable pre-end checkpoint existed in /slots (0 < n_tokens <= min(lcp, n_task-1), n_tokens >= min tokens, hash equal), (c) B1, B2, B4 have n_fork_tokens > 0, (d) every child's first-token top-1 equals the cold run's and its max-abs prob / coarse KL are within max(fresh-vs-fresh floor, 1e-4) of this run. Fork-off: every child n_fork_tokens == 0.
181.C: Trunk-length sweep: >= 16 lengths L0 + k*stride (stride = ub // 16, one -ub period), one trunk group; for each length slot 0 prefills trunk[:L]+tail with checkpoint_at=[L]; the fork child (trunk[:L]+suffix0), then two cold runs (cache_prompt false) on slots 2 and 3 give the fresh-vs-fresh floor. Run with the drafter on and off (speculative.n_max 0 on every request). SATISFIED iff for EVERY length n_fork_tokens == L and the child is within the floor: top-1 equal, max-abs prob and coarse KL each <= max(the largest fresh-vs-fresh value over this run's lengths, 1e-4).
181.D: Hit-count prediction: one source (trunk T + long tail, checkpoint_at=[T]) holds the junction T and the two near-end checkpoints N-4-ub and N-4. For each c in {T, N-4-ub, N-4} and delta in {-1, 0, +1} a child shares exactly c+delta tokens with the source and then diverges (distinct next token). One launch per drafter configuration (as given, no drafter, others given). SATISFIED for a configuration iff every cell n_fork_tokens == the KPF-11 prediction and no cell has n_fork_tokens == 0 while the prediction is > 0 (an unidentified drafter configuration must not disable fork reuse). A drafter-dependent drop is MEASURED once, at a held-out shared length that is not any c-1/c/c+1: drop = predicted - observed there, plus a cold-run first-token comparison at that length; the drop is recorded, never subtracted from the main cells.
